name: year-12-swe-at-1
description: This guided tutorial will introduce HSC Software Engineering to the basics of developing websites with the [node.JS framework](https://nodejs.org/en). The tutorial has been specifically designed for requirements in the [NESA Software Engineering Syllabus](https://curriculum.nsw.edu.au/learning-areas/tas/software-engineering-11-12-2022/content/n12/fa6aab137e) and for students in NSW Department of Education schools using eT4L computers.
